entries.subject: Size: Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006) Table 3 radius
entries.finding: Psamathe is drawn at the 20 km radius that Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006), Table 3, estimate for S/2003 N1 from its R-band brightness with an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04; JPL's satellite discovery table identifies S/2003 N1 as Psamathe. The size rests on the assumed albedo and is not a measurement.
